name: eased-layout
title: Eased layout
description: Alignment recipes for repeating rows: rowGrid and rowGridRow share a leading, a flexible and a fixed trailing track, so every row's role or value starts on one x.

files.content:
/** * Alignment recipes for rules 101–109, as class strings to compose with your own. * * rowGrid a list whose rows share tracks: leading item, flexible text, then a fixed * trailing column set by `--col` (default 5rem). Rows are `rowGridRow`, which * subgrids the parent, so every role, menu or value starts on one x (R102, R103). * rowGridRow one row of a `rowGrid`. Add a height (`h-9`) and any row padding. * *
    *
  • …Can edit
    • *
*/ export const rowGrid = "grid grid-cols-[auto_minmax(0,1fr)_var(--col,5rem)] items-center"; export const rowGridRow = "col-span-full grid grid-cols-subgrid items-center";
